_comment: DATA-DRIVEN runner disk-reclaim policy (FRIC-017 productization, pipeline-glue(b), ADR-0548 pipeline-as-product). The Rust-first preflight binary oya-cloud-ci-runner-disk-reclaim reads this file and, for the requested runner profile, best-effort removes the listed vendor preinstall dirs BEFORE the multi-GB buck-out warm restore, then ASSERTS the post-reclaim free-disk floor. Replaces the two duplicated inline `sudo rm -rf` blocks in .github/workflows/oya-ci-required.yml (the buck2 + gate-affected-set jobs) per the founder doctrine 'new automation never ships as shell'. Each profile names the reclaim_dirs (best-effort, like the old `|| true`) + min_free_gib_after (the post-reclaim floor; below it the preflight emits a distinct INFRA-RED signal so a downstream disk-exhaustion is attributable to INFRA, not CODE). The dirs are vendor preinstall trees that no oya/buck2 action consumes; removing them touches NO repo content and NO cache (buck-out / ~/.rustup / the restored blob), so the ADR-0556/0560 cold==warm integrity canary is unaffected.

github-hosted-ubuntu-latest._comment: GitHub-hosted ubuntu-latest carries ~25-30 GiB of .NET/Android/GHC/CodeQL vendor preinstall on a runner with only ~14 GiB free on /. The buck-out warm restore decompresses a ~5.78 GiB blob (~12-15 GiB on disk) on top of a fetch-depth:0 monorepo checkout, exhausting / (FRIC-017: 'No space left on device' at restore, before any build ran). The 5 dirs are the vendor preinstall trees removed by the retired inline shell.
